subject: Leveling floor, probe cadence, and debrief flow for Senior LLM Serving role
messages:
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@talentpro.io>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Leveling floor, probe cadence, and debrief flow for Senior LLM Serving role

Hi team —

We have a promising slate for the Senior LLM Serving hire (CAND-4821). Before interviews next week I want to lock down three things so feedback is consistent and we avoid noisy debriefs:

1) Leveling floor — what would we accept as a minimal pass for this role? (examples: independent design of batching/kv cache strategies, tradeoffs across quantized pipelines, clear SLO reasoning)
2) Probe cadence — short list of behavioral/technical probes per slot so interviewers cover non-overlapping areas.
3) Debrief flow — single score sheet, explicit red/yellow/green criteria, and who owns the final leveling call.

Attached: latest resume, a first pass probe matrix, and a debrief template.

Quick asks: can you both review the probe matrix and suggest one adjustment each by Monday EOD? Also confirm who will own the leveling call (I can but happy to defer).

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Hiring Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CAND-4821_Resume.pdf (resume), probe_matrix_Sr-LLM-Serving.xlsx (probe matrix), debrief-template.md (scoring template)
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leveling floor, probe cadence, and debrief flow for Senior LLM Serving role

Thanks, Olga — reviewed the matrix quickly. High-level thoughts:

- Leveling floor: I agree with the "independent design" baseline but would add "can concretely describe worst-case and amortized latency tradeoffs for 1k qps under 2 seq lengths" as a required signal.
- Probe cadence: The current probes double up on latency micro-optimizations in two different slots. Suggest swapping one of those for a systems-design scenario focused on fallback/routing policies (routing + fallback is a strong Redwood differentiation).
- Debrief flow: We should add an explicit test for quantitative reasoning in the debrief template (simple token-cost/throughput calc).

I can take ownership of the leveling call on Thurs (17th) 11:30am PT if that works for everyone.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Olga / Markus —

Thanks for kicking this off. My quick read:

- Leveling floor: add a "collaboration/leadership" behavioral anchor. For senior roles we need someone who can drive cross-team tradeoffs (infra, product, security). Example signal: led an incident postmortem that resulted in a change to fallback policy and measured latency improvement.
- Probe cadence: propose 3 probes per interviewer (30-min slot): 1 systems/design, 1 coding/optimization sketch (whiteboard or pseudo), 1 behavioral. This reduces overlap and ensures behavioral signal is captured.
- Debrief flow: I like Markus' scoring calc ask. Also suggest we require one concrete example from the candidate that maps to each critical competency on the scorecard (helps avoid vague "strong" labels).

I prefer Olga own the initial leveling call and Markus be second sign-off. Olga, if you own it we can slot the call Fri 17th 11:30 PT (Markus had proposed Thurs but Friday gives the team time to do interviews).

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Recruiting Partner (Technical Hiring)
Redwood Inference

All —

Thanks for the quick turns. Final decisions:

- Leveling floor revised: must demonstrate independent architecture tradeoffs for batching/kv cache, describe routing/fallback policy w/ SLO considerations, and show one incident-driven improvement example (behavioral).
- Probe cadence: 3 focused probes per interviewer (systems/design; coding/optimization sketch; behavioral). I've updated the matrix to swap one latency micro-optimization for routing/fallback and added a behavioral anchor column.
- Debrief flow: Use the attached debrief-template.md. Scoring: 1-4 per competency, with a required quantitative justification for any score >=3. Olga to run initial leveling call; Markus as secondary reviewer.

Leveling call scheduled: Fri, 17 Nov 2026 11:30am PT (calendar invite sent). Sanjay — thanks for the packet. Laura — I'll own the call.

Next steps: Sanjay please send final packet to interviewers. Panel — please read the probe matrix before your slot and be prepared to collect 1 concrete example per competency.

Regards,
Olga
Hiring Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
